title: SR-Scientist: Scientific Equation Discovery With Agentic AI
venue: The Fourteenth International Conference on Learning Representations

publication.venue: The Fourteenth International Conference on Learning Representations

parentSelection: Rank-Based Selection (contextual top-K retrieval; direct parent relation unconfirmed)

mechanism.domainTask: LLM-agentic scientific equation discovery / symbolic regression
mechanism.populationDetail: A global experience buffer/ranked heap retains explored equations and scores; no islands or maintained genealogy are described.
mechanism.archiveDetail: The same experience buffer/ranked heap preserves multiple high-performing equations and retrieves the best K for later iterations; no separate archive apart from this main memory is identified.
mechanism.replacementDetail: The global history grows by appending iteration outputs; top-K retrieval filters context without replacing or deleting the accumulated history.
mechanism.generationDetail: The agent proposes equation hypotheses during a tool-using trajectory; no direct single-parent editing or multi-parent fusion protocol is specified.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: The online optimization target is MAPE; evaluator observations guide the ongoing trajectory, and historical equation scores are retrieved in later iterations. Benchmark accuracy-to-tolerance and symbolic accuracy are reporting metrics, not the online search signal.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: Record this as rank-based contextual reference retrieval, not verified genealogical parent selection. The source is the same experience structure classified as population/archive.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: Long-horizon tool-using autonomous scientific discovery and RL training of an agent for equation discovery are not fully represented by the current mechanism labels.
